brief.zh: 标出主干，把修饰成分折起来。
brief.en: Mark the skeleton, folding the modifier away.

t.zh: 修饰成分也跟在宾语后面。这时它不挡路，但同样不属于主干。
t.en: A modifier can follow the object too. There it is in nobody’s way, but it is still no part of the skeleton.

hint.zh: with linear running time 说的是什么东西的性质？
hint.en: What is with linear running time a property of?

sentence: We describe an algorithm with linear running time.

describe.zh: 挂在 describe 上，意思就成了“用线性的运行时间去描述”。with 在这里说的是算法本身的性质。
describe.en: Hung on describe, it would mean describing by means of linear running time. Here with gives a property of the algorithm itself.

title.zh: We describe an algorithm with linear running time.
title.en: We describe an algorithm with linear running time.

body.zh: 主干 We describe an algorithm；with linear running time 说明是什么样的算法：运行时间为线性的算法。
body.en: The skeleton is We describe an algorithm; with linear running time says what kind: an algorithm that runs in linear time.

note.zh: 宾语的修饰成分也折到宾语的中心词上。
note.en: An object’s modifiers fold onto the object’s head too.
